title: Make dispatch retries idempotent
prompt: A caller may retry Dispatcher#dispatch with the same shipment id after losing the first response. Make dispatch idempotent across Dispatcher instances that share the same DispatchLog. A repeated shipment id must return the original route without reserving inventory or appending another log entry. Preserve the existing public dispatch call, persist enough information in DispatchLog, and add tests for a retry through a new Dispatcher instance. Assume one local process and do not add concurrency handling.

workflows: look up a shipment id before reserving inventory
return the persisted route for a retry
reserve and append only for a new shipment
concepts: the dispatch log is the durable idempotency record
invariants: one shipment id produces at most one reservation and one log entry
rubric.impact_question: If dispatch must later be safe across multiple processes, which current components and invariants are insufficient and where would coordination need to be introduced?
accepted_alternatives: persist and query the original route in DispatchLog
introduce a separate durable idempotency store

runtime_only_if_observed: an in-memory deduplication approach that was rejected
evidence that moved idempotency ownership into DispatchLog
